sn22.70:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.70:1.3: sādhu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.70:1.4: yaṃ kho bhikkhu, rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti.
sn22.70:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi?
sn22.70:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante, rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ, tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.70:2.3: vedanā rajanīyasaṇṭhitā, tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.70:2.6: viññāṇaṃ rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ, tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.70:2.7: imassa kho’haṃ bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī’ti.
sn22.70:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.70:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu, rajanīya saṇṭhitaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.70:3.7: viññāṇaṃ rajanīyasaṇṭhitaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.70:3.8: imassa kho bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti. atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkami. atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi. khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn22.70:3.9: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
